turns.text: I can process the refund for you. How did you originally pay?

turns.prompt: 关于「退款问题」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I paid by credit card.

feedback.naturalExpression: I paid by credit card.
feedback.explanation: “I paid”交代已使用的付款方式，方便查账或办理退款。

choices.text: I used this card.

feedback.naturalExpression: I used this card.
feedback.explanation: “I used”交代之前采用的信息或方法，便于对方核对记录。

choices.text: I paid with my phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I paid with my phone.
feedback.explanation: “I paid”交代已使用的付款方式，方便查账或办理退款。

choices.text: I think I paid in cash.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I paid by credit card.
feedback.explanation: “I think”准确表达记不清付款方式；不确定时可以这样说，再协助核查。

turns.text: Okay. The refund will go back to your original payment method.

turns.prompt: 你想确认款项何时退回或解除冻结，会怎么问？

choices.text: How long will the refund take?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long will the refund take?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: When should I expect to see the refund?

feedback.naturalExpression: When should I expect to see the refund?
feedback.explanation: “when should I expect”询问预计何时会发生，适合确认到账、送达等需要等待的事项。

choices.text: Will it go back to the same card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will it go back to the same card?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Will I get a confirmation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I get a confirmation?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

turns.text: It usually takes a few business days.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Okay. Could I have a refund receipt, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could I have a refund receipt, please?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll keep an eye on my account.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll keep an eye on my account.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜退款迟迟不到账
scenarios.setting: 玩家几天前已经办理退款，但钱一直没有到账。

turns.prompt: 关于「退款问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’m calling about a refund I haven’t received yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m calling about a refund I haven’t received yet.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: I was issued a refund last week, but it hasn’t appeared in my account.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was issued a refund last week, but it hasn’t appeared in my account.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Could you check the status of my refund, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check the status of my refund, please?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: I’m still waiting for a refund from a return I made last week.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still waiting for a refund from a return I made last week.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Where is my refund?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m calling about a refund I haven’t received yet.
feedback.explanation: 只问钱在哪里，缺少交易信息；提供退款日期或订单号，再问进度，更容易查询。

turns.text: Sure. Do you have the refund reference number?

turns.prompt: 关于「退款问题」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes. It’s RF28416.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. It’s RF28416.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: I have the refund receipt here. Would that help?

feedback.naturalExpression: I have the refund receipt here. Would that help?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: I’m not sure where to find the reference number. Could you tell me?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure where to find the reference number. Could you tell me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: I can see that the refund was processed three days ago.

turns.prompt: 你想确认款项何时退回或解除冻结，会怎么问？

choices.text: Do you know when it should appear in my account?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know when it should appear in my account?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: Has the money already been sent from your side?

feedback.naturalExpression: Has the money already been sent from your side?
feedback.explanation: “already”强调事情已经发生或完成，适合核对进度与时间先后。

choices.text: Is there anything I need to do?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I need to do?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Who should I contact if it still doesn’t arrive?

feedback.naturalExpression: Who should I contact if it still doesn’t arrive?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

turns.text: If you don’t see it within another two business days, please contact us again.

turns.prompt: 关于「退款问题」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll wait another two days. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll wait another two days. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “more / extra / another”表示在已有数量上增加，能说明是补充需求。

choices.text: Could you send me confirmation that the refund was processed?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you send me confirmation that the refund was processed?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Great. I’ll contact you again if it doesn’t arrive.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll contact you again if it doesn’t arrive.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜商家拒绝退款
scenarios.setting: 在“退款问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“商家拒绝退款”。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but we can’t offer a refund for this item.

turns.prompt: 你想了解退换或退款的处理办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you explain why the refund can’t be issued?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain why the refund can’t be issued?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Could you tell me why this isn’t eligible for a refund?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me why this isn’t eligible for a refund?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: I thought this item could be returned. Could you explain the policy?

feedback.naturalExpression: I thought this item could be returned. Could you explain the policy?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there a specific reason you can’t refund it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a specific reason you can’t refund it?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Why won’t you give me my money back?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain why the refund can’t be issued?
feedback.explanation: 反问可能让店员感到被质问；问清退款受哪项条件限制，更便于讨论解决办法。

turns.text: This type of item is final sale, so it isn’t eligible for a refund.

turns.prompt: 你想解释自己购买时对退货限制的了解，会怎么说？

choices.text: I see. I wasn’t aware that it was final sale when I bought it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. I wasn’t aware that it was final sale when I bought it.
feedback.explanation: “final sale”通常指不退换的最终销售；提到是否知情，能说明争议来自哪项条件。

choices.text: Was that stated somewhere at the time of purchase?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was that stated somewhere at the time of purchase?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Could you show me where the final-sale policy is listed?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you show me where the final-sale policy is listed?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there any exception if the item is faulty?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any exception if the item is faulty?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。
